# EVERY1 Movement: how to use the mark

> The published brand standard for the EVERY1 Movement: which mark, on which ground,
> how much room it needs, and what never to do. EVERY1 carries no parent endorsement
> line and no parent lockup.

## Start here

- [Manifest](https://brand.every1movement.com/ai/manifest.json): every mark, its clear space, its minimum size, and its files, with the palette and the typefaces.
- [How to use the mark](https://brand.every1movement.com/): the same thing for people.

## Facts at a glance

Brand version 7.5, updated 2026-08-20.
EVERY1 stands alone. Do not add "A ministry of THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD" and do not lock a parent mark to it.
Flame never carries text and is never a ground under text. Fire at text size is Ember.
Contact brand@theword.world for a country lockup that is not published yet.
